deferred_groups.reason: International UI variants, font bundling, replacement branding, community controls and publication workflows are excluded.
3D/lighting, image-tracing architecture, Linux font discovery, scripting and embedding need separate compatibility/platform reviews.
SVG unit/primitive proposals, newer stroke-outline behavior, wide import changes and coincident Join remain candidates for separate focused validation.
The proposed shared-appearance stroke cache repair requires the newer upstream renderer/cache contract; it is not transplanted into Vectnor's earlier cache.
The plain-fsync repair is adapted, but replacing atomic saves with direct overwrite when temporary-file/rename operations fail needs a separate data-loss review.
